card.title: Left, Right, Straight
card.tagline: Apprenez à donner et comprendre une direction simple.

sentence.french: Tournez à gauche, puis continuez tout droit.

song.title: Left Right Straight
song.description: Une chanson rythmée pour retenir les directions de base.
lyrics: Turn left, turn right, then walk straight on,
Turn left, turn right, then walk straight on,
Gently now, we won't be gone.
A quiet path, a gentle way,
Left and right, then straight all day.
Turn left, turn right, so soft, so slow,
Straight ahead is where we go.
Turn left, turn right, then walk straight on,
Turn left, turn right, then walk straight on,
Gently now, we won't be gone.
